products.name: Vintage Ornaments Christmas
products.description: A vintage-inspired Christmas card with hellebores, roses, and antique ornaments on soft sage green, finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas” and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Plum Hellebore Christmas
products.description: A dreamy Christmas card with plum and cream hellebores, silvery eucalyptus, and sprigs of red berries on a dusty mauve background touched with lace and falling snow. Finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas” and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Woodland Rose Christmas
products.description: A cozy, old-fashioned Christmas card filled with crimson and blush roses, holly, pine sprigs, pinecones, and clusters of red and white berries on a warm, weathered background. Finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas” and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Vintage Ice Skates Christmas
products.description: A charming, nostalgic Christmas card featuring a pair of antique ice skates nestled among plum blooms, cream hellebores, and pink winter berries on a lace-patterned mauve background. Finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas” and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Winter Rose Garden Christmas
products.description: A lush Christmas card bursting with blush, crimson, and deep burgundy roses, a snowy white peony, and frosted berries on a soft sage background with a lacy snowflake. Finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas,” gold accents, and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Champagne Rose Christmas
products.description: A soft, elegant Christmas card with champagne and peach roses, white anemones, and rosy berries drifting across a blush background with delicate snowflakes. Finished with a gold foil “Merry Christmas” and a star-embossed side panel. Sentiment inside reads "May the spirit of the season be with you throughout the New Year."

products.name: Wise Men Still Seek Him Christmas
products.description: A meaningful Christmas card showing the three kings riding golden camels beneath the Star of Bethlehem, set against a deep midnight sky scattered with gold stars. The words “Wise men still seek Him” sit beneath the journey, and the panel is mounted on rich red cardstock. Inside reads “Merry Christmas.”

products.name: Christ is Born Christmas
products.description: A simple, striking Christmas card with “Christ is Born” hand-lettered in bold black script with golden highlights, surrounded by graceful olive branches on a creamy background. Layered over black and evergreen cardstock for a crisp, classic finish. Inside reads “Merry Christmas.”

products.name: Joy to the World Christmas
products.description: A reverent Christmas card featuring a kneeling angel in a soft white gown with shimmering golden wings, bowed in prayer on a deep burgundy background. Beside her, the beloved hymn lyric “Joy to the world, the Lord is come, let earth receive her King!” is lettered in elegant white, all framed in warm golden cardstock. Inside reads “Merry Christmas.”

products.name: Garden Bloom Thank You
products.description:
A cheerful thank you card with a bold floral panel of poppy red, coral, and olive blooms set among deep green leaves. A hand-cut stem rises up the center, topped with a raised flower detailed in gold, while a stitched green banner carries “Thank You” in shimmering gold. Finished with sparkling gems on a crisp cream base. Inside reads "For all the wonderful things you do."

Matching cards are available as a set.

products.name: Watercolor Thistle Thank You
products.description: A soft, artistic thank you card featuring wild magenta thistles drifting across a watercolor sky that melts from teal to golden sunlight. Framed in rich orchid cardstock with a “thank you very much” sentiment and three iridescent aqua gems that catch the light. Inside is ready for your personalized message.

products.name: Garden Bloom Thank You SET (6)
products.description: Three coordinating designs in one beautiful set, all featuring the same bold floral pattern in poppy red, coral, olive, and deep green. Includes two gatefold cards that open from the center with a “thank you” tag and dimensional blooms, three cards with diagonal strips of florals, stripes, and solid color, and one card framed in bright red with a gold “Thank You” and sparkling gems. Inside reads on all cards "For all the wonderful things you do."

products.name: Songbird Thank You SET (6)
products.description: Three sweet watercolor designs, two of each, to show someone how much you appreciate them. Each card features a charming songbird framed in a stitched circle above a “Thinking of You” sentiment, set against delicate blossom-covered backgrounds. In coral, blue, and green. Inside is waiting for you personal message of gratitude.

products.name: Watercolor Meadow Thank You SET (3)
products.description:
Three artful thank you cards inspired by a wildflower meadow at dusk, with soft watercolor washes in mauve, honey gold, sage, and sky blue. Each features deckled edges, gold accents, and a “Thank You” sentiment:
Olive: diagonal strips of earthy watercolor meadow with a cut-out stem of orchid blooms, on olive green.
Plum: a dreamy painted landscape of blue sky fading to pink wildflowers, layered on plum and olive.
Lavender: brighter diagonal strips in orchid, gold, and aqua with a cut-out flowering stem, on soft lavender.

products.name: Lavender Farmhouse Thank You SET (3)
products.description:
Three charming thank you cards filled with the cozy, country feel of a lavender farm. Each is crisply layered in black and white with a script “Thank You” sentiment:
Library Card: a vintage lavender library due-date card lettered with “Thank You,” surrounded by embossed lavender sprigs.
Floral Window: cream and lavender blooms with a tiny bee on a rich chocolate background, beside farmhouse window scenes with baskets of lavender.
Pantry Shelves: a strip of rustic pantry shelves lined with jars and potted lavender, opening onto rolling lavender fields, set against a lavender bouquet pattern with purple accents.

products.name: A Big Thank You Peony
products.description: A lush, romantic thank you card with painted pink roses, tender buds, and deep green leaves on a soft cream background. In the corner, a stitched pocket holds two dimensional pink blooms in layered stamped detail, tucked among fresh green leaves. The cheerful “A big thank you!” sentiment sits beside them, all framed in black and rose red.

products.name: Coral Bluebird Thinking of You
products.description: A sweet watercolor bluebird perches on a branch of purple blossoms in a stitched circle frame. It sits against a soft pink floral background with coral card stock. The “Thinking of You” sentiment is stamped in matching coral ink on a decorative label. Blank inside.

products.name: Teal Bluebird Thinking of You
products.description: A watercolor bluebird rests among pink blossoms in a stitched square frame. The lavender floral paper and teal card stock give it a fresh, spring-like feel. “Thinking of You” is stamped in teal on a scalloped label. Blank inside.

products.name: Sending Hugs – Autumn Leaf Wreath
products.description: A wreath of die-cut maple and oak leaves in orange, golden yellow, and green surrounds a warm “Sending Hugs” sentiment. An orange buffalo plaid panel on the fold-out side adds a cozy fall touch, and tiny gem accents add a bit of sparkle. Blank inside.

products.name: May His Amazing Love Touch Your Heart
products.description: This gate-fold style card is covered in a rich floral print of red, mustard, and blue blooms on deep green. A diamond-shaped sentiment panel with a die-cut leafy branch sits at the center. Opening the gate reveals the inside. Blank inside.

products.name: You Have Filled My Heart with Great Joy – Psalm 4:7
products.description: A bold stamped lilac bloom in layered shades of blue with green leaves fills this elegant card. The scripture sentiment sits on a label with sparkling gem accents, framed in royal blue and black layers. Blank inside.

products.name: I Can Do All Things Through Christ – Philippians 4:13
products.description: A watercolor pine forest scene with purple wildflowers sits on a side-fold card tied with a bright orchid ribbon. The inside features a scripture verse with a small leafy sprig. A thoughtful card to encourage someone who needs strength.

products.name: Pastel Butterflies Thinking of You SET (5)
products.description: This set of five cards has a bold black die-cut “thinking of you” sentiment across a band of floral patterned paper. The five pastel colors are apricot, sage, lavender, soft yellow, and sky blue. A white embossed panel, black layering, and three fluttering die-cut butterflies finish each front. Inside, a sketched butterfly stamp accompanies the message “Hope is a beautiful thing that flutters in the soul.” Each card comes with a matching envelope, finished with a larger sketched butterfly stamp.

products.name: Sage Leaf Sympathy
products.description: A tall sage green panel with a white embossed leafy branch stands out against a white card with a soft, wood-grain texture. A black-edged label holds the “with sympathy” sentiment. Inside, the verse reads “May you feel sheltered in the love that surrounds you.”

products.name: Rose Gold Foil Leaves Sympathy
products.description: Shimmering rose gold foil leaves cascade down the center of a clean white card, framed by two thin rose gold foil lines. A small stamped label holds the “with sympathy” sentiment. Inside, the verse reads “May you feel sheltered in the love that surrounds you.”

products.name: White Dragonfly on Navy Paper Sympathy
products.description: A white heat-embossed dragonfly hovers over a rich navy floral background, with “with sympathy” embossed in matching white. Inside, the message reads “May you find peace and comfort in this difficult time and know that you are loved.”
